description: Revision 3 of mcp.knowledge-capture and of its 23 allowlisted MCP Tool rows, from a recapture of the Knowledge Services executor at 1a451fd (42 tools, large input schemas in their published short form). The allowlist is revision 2's plus chain_write, evidence_units, knowledge_describe, source_prepare_captured, so a research agent can make its capture quotable and record a claim anchored to a quote; knowledge ingestion, direct database reads, checkpoints, schema_materialize, artifact_get and the issuer-credential tools stay withheld. Host support is revision 2's. No 1.2.0 record is repeated.

definition.description: The Knowledge Services executor's MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP, /mcp) narrowed to the research method from capture to a proposed claim: capture a URL or a file as exact bytes, read and search a capture, locate a quote that occurs once, export a fragment, register and read artifacts, make a capture quotable as a database capture (source_prepare_captured), find quotable content units (evidence_units), write one governed step of the verification chain (chain_write: a claim anchored to a quote, a probe, a verdict proposal; never a verification and never a person's judgment), record source discovery and lead selection, read the schema workspace, a tool's or a chain operation's full description (knowledge_describe) and the guidance. Withheld: ingest_*, db_*, checkpoint_*, schema_materialize, artifact_get, knowledge_operation_* and knowledge_receipt_get. The endpoint is the executor's local default; a deployment binds its own (MCP_SERVER_ENDPOINTS). VERIFY_EXECUTOR_TOKEN names the token the executor expects on the Authorization header. Supported on the Deep Agents lane, which attaches only this allowlist; unqualified on the other worker-hosted lanes.
definition.title: Knowledge Services evidence capture: capture, locate, source and schema tools

tools.description: Return an orchestration.artifact row (intent, snapshot, plan, receipt, report) with its JSON or text body when the bytes are available.
tools.name: artifact_get

tools.description: One governed write: record_claim, restate_claim, record_triage, register_probe, record_probe_run, propose_verdict, record_source_assessment, raise_attention_sweep, settle_attention_sweep. Proposals only: never verifies a claim, never a person's judgment. Read knowledge_describe operation:<name>.
tools.name: chain_write

tools.description: Verify complete remote artifact closure and atomically advance the expected scoped checkpoint head.
tools.name: checkpoint_commit

tools.description: Host adapter for approved files, executor state and tool observations. Returns a verified durable receipt; continuation remains blocked on unresolved owner work.
tools.name: checkpoint_harness

tools.description: Read the latest committed receipt for an exact standalone session scope.
tools.name: checkpoint_head

tools.description: Verify archived bytes and manifest without resuming work.
tools.name: checkpoint_read

tools.description: Verify checkpoint closure and reconcile pending work through its existing owner before continuation.
tools.name: checkpoint_restore

tools.description: Apply reference-aware retirement after the canonical minimum orphan age; referenced artifacts cannot be retired.
tools.name: checkpoint_tombstone

tools.description: Return the JSON query plan (no ANALYZE) for one SELECT/WITH statement as pipeline_agent. Use it to check cost before running a heavy read.
tools.name: db_explain

tools.description: Return the tenant's knowledge_seq (the head every snapshot and ingestion intent cites) and the database migration head.
tools.name: db_head

tools.description: Execute named catalog queries in one read-only transaction at one knowledge head and return a knowledge-read-snapshot.v1 with per-op and snapshot digests. persist:true stores intent+snapshot as artifacts.
tools.name: db_read_intent

tools.description: Run ONE SELECT/WITH statement as pipeline_agent in a read-only transaction with a statement timeout and row cap. No writes, no set_config. Prefer catalog queries (db_read_intent) when one fits.
tools.name: db_sql_readonly

tools.description: Find content units of the knowledge base by capture, document, unit, URL or text, each with the capture it was read from. A row's anchor {capture_id, node_id} plus a verbatim quote of its text is an evidence anchor for chain_write record_claim. Name at least one filter.
tools.name: evidence_units

tools.description: Plan, then apply admitted proposals in one transaction as executor_service via temporal.begin_batch/assert_*/commit_batch; return a knowledge-ingestion-receipt.v1. Same bytes ⇒ same receipt (duplicateOf). REBASE_REQUIRED when the head moved.
tools.name: ingest_apply

tools.description: Validate a knowledge-ingestion-intent.v1 against vocabularies, rules, evidence, and the current head; return a knowledge-ingestion-plan.v1 with per-proposal outcomes. Writes nothing.
tools.name: ingest_plan

tools.description: Return the stored knowledge-ingestion-receipt.v1 for a receiptId (orchestration.operation_receipt.id).
tools.name: ingest_receipt

tools.description: ref tool:<name>: the full input schema of one tool of this server. ref operation:<name>: one verification-chain operation of chain_write (input, rules, example, role). No ref: binding-descriptor.v2 of the credential's binding (protocol, operations, report kinds, guarantees).
tools.name: knowledge_describe

tools.description:
Read the guidance as Markdown: the start page, or one skill or one reference of a skill.
Call it first, without a topic, for the jobs, the skill and the tools of each job and the rules that always hold.
Returns one Markdown page that ends with the topics it links to. Read a skill, then only the reference the step you are on needs.
tools.name: knowledge_guide

tools.description: Idempotent cancellation by cancelRequestId: the first request id is kept; queued operations cancel, running or waiting_review ones move to cancelling and settle cancelled.
tools.name: knowledge_operation_cancel

tools.description: Poll one operation handle by operationId (scope from the credential). Returns operation-status.v2 with a bounded retryAfterMs while not terminal.
tools.name: knowledge_operation_get

tools.description: Send one ks.knowledge_operation.v2 operation-envelope.v2. Returns operation-receipt.v2 for a synchronous effect (report.register, knowledge.apply), knowledge-plan-preview.v1 for the read-only knowledge.plan_preview, knowledge-read-intent-result.v1 for the recorded read-only knowledge.read_intent (allowlisted named queries and schema reads), or operation-handle.v2 (knowledge.read, report.assess, report.derive, report.observe, report.seal, report.decide, report.review, decision.resolve). A binding serves only the operations its knowledge_describe descriptor lists. Refusals are protocol-error.v2.
tools.name: knowledge_operation_invoke

tools.description: Receipt-first recovery: receipt-lookup.v2 for one effect key (found, not_found or unresolved). A negative lookup after an uncertain dispatch is not proof that nothing was applied.
tools.name: knowledge_receipt_get

tools.description: Return a workspace page by id (rel:<schema>.<name>, dom:<slug>, task:<slug>, fn:<schema>.<name>) or relative path, capped in size. Search before reading; read the domain page before a relation page; ≤4 reads to an operation.
tools.name: schema_get

tools.description: Return the workspace manifest (fingerprint, migration head, scope) plus the connected database's migration head and whether they match.
tools.name: schema_manifest

tools.description: Copy a scoped workspace bundle (workspace-scopes/<scope>.json) into an empty directory, via the db-contract CLI when present, else an in-process filter.
tools.name: schema_materialize

tools.description: Find tables, functions, domains, tasks, queries, and terms in the pinned schema workspace. Ranked: exact alias > name > tokens. Search before reading; read the domain page before a relation page; ≤4 reads to an operation.
tools.name: schema_search

tools.description: Read the original source attempt and its provenance trust. Terminal leads require verified remote receipt custody. An unfinished attempt returns no leads and must be reconciled before any new provider dispatch.
tools.name: source_attempt

tools.description: Dispatch a configured search provider after durable request registration; preserve output before returning its receipt. Snippets remain untrusted discovery material. Reuse the idempotency key to recover the original attempt.
tools.name: source_discover

tools.description: Account for externally executed provider attempts using already preserved receipt artifacts. Imported metadata is self-reported and never gains managed-provider authority.
tools.name: source_import

tools.description: Register a capture you made (verify_capture_source or verify_capture_file) as an evidence capture with quotable units, so chain_write can anchor to it. Text, Markdown, HTML, JSON; other types refused. Same bytes: same capture. quotes: get anchors back.
tools.name: source_prepare_captured

tools.description: Recover an original managed attempt from verified completion custody under a fresh fence. Does not call the provider again. Refuses a live dispatch lease; missing completion custody yields an explicit uncertain outcome.
tools.name: source_reconcile

tools.description: Preserve explicit selected, omitted or duplicate lead decisions and reasons in an immutable selection receipt. Does not rewrite provider output, admit evidence or authorize publication.
tools.name: source_select

tools.description: Capture bytes instead of a URL: markdown/text/json inline as `text`, or any supported document (pdf, docx, doc, odt, rtf, xlsx, xls, pptx, ppt, epub, csv, html) as `base64`. The executor converts the document to markdown itself (Firecrawl parse) and stores the original bytes beside the text, so the capture is trustworthy evidence. Sandbox files are normally pushed through the HTTP POST /captures route instead of inlining base64.
tools.name: verify_capture_file

tools.description: Resolve a unique quote against an exact representation digest and return a research-core.fragment.v2 with original capture custody and acquisition-time provenance. Requires durable artifact custody. Tenant is host-owned; rights are producer-declared and registration/admission remain separate.
tools.name: verify_capture_fragment

tools.description: Fetch a URL (Firecrawl when configured, otherwise HTTPS GET), store the captured text as an immutable content-addressed artifact, and return a captureId plus a preview. Quotes used in intents must be exact substrings of this captured text.
tools.name: verify_capture_source

tools.description: Fetch a stored artifact by artifactId or digest (as text, json or just the handle).
tools.name: verify_get_artifact

tools.description: List every capture in the store with its digest and size.
tools.name: verify_list_captures

tools.description: Resolve a candidate quote as a text_quote selector on the captured bytes. status=resolved means it occurs exactly once and is safe to put in an intent; ambiguous/not_found include suggestions.
tools.name: verify_locate_quote

tools.description: Read a window of the exact captured text (default 6000 chars, max 20000). Use this to inspect the source before choosing quotes.
tools.name: verify_read_capture

tools.description: Store text (an intent file, a report, notes) as a content-addressed artifact and get back its artifactId/digest. Sandbox files are normally pushed via the HTTP /artifacts route instead.
tools.name: verify_register_artifact

tools.description: Find where a phrase (or the words of a phrase) occurs in a capture. Returns exact substrings with context and their occurrence counts so you can build a unique quote.
tools.name: verify_search_capture

tools.description: List every content type the executor can capture and how each is converted to the text representation quotes are selected from.
tools.name: verify_supported_media_types
